description: One collection's market: floor (in its coin and dollars), listed count, owners, 24h and 7d volume and sales, its floor over the last 7 days (each day's closing floor), the floor change over 24h and 7 days with the floor 7 days ago it's measured from, real (not wash-traded) sales and buyers over 7 days, and its top flippers.
